title: symphyotrichum cordifolium var. lanceolatum
intro: Symphyotrichum cordifolium var. lanceolatum, commonly known as Lance-leaved Heart-leaved Aster, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Lance-leaved Heart-leaved Aster include its ability to act as an anti-anxiety agent and a sedative, while also exhibiting antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
